scope: 42 supplied English cards for existing notes; resolved through the approved path map. Existing detailed text and PNG pixels are preserved.
review_method: Opened every supplied image at full resolution in a two-card inspection sheet. Read original-paper method, result-table attribution and limitations; cross-checked numeric tokens against the same-revision PDF. Token presence supplements manual dataset/protocol attribution rather than verifying it automatically.

papers.method_review: Predict camera-agnostic per-pixel rays with spherical harmonics; cross-view inference predicts radial distance/confidence and relative pose. Multi-view ray-aware global alignment optimizes poses/scales while retaining local geometry.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3–4 and Appendix E: strong cross-camera pose/reconstruction across 2D3DS, 360Loc, ADT and CO3Dv2 under synthetic camera projections; no universal-win claim.
papers.qualifications_review: Two encoders and exhaustive pairs cost memory/compute; global alignment adds optimization, and global scale is not metric.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Low-resolution alternating-attention geometry is fused with per-frame high-resolution MoGe2 features through cross-scale positional alignment and an attention adapter; pi3 distillation is training-only.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 5: 100-frame clips, 2048×1024, one A100, DAGE 5.6 FPS and 27.9 GB. Video pointmaps use shared scale/shift alignment; sharpness is tested on synthetic scenes.
papers.qualifications_review: Poor overlap, rapid nonrigid motion and high-resolution memory remain; dynamic motion is not recovered.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Temporal per-camera attention and calibration-aware cross-camera attention separate rig poses from ego-motion; known camera baselines recover metric scale.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1: nuScenes six-camera evaluation, 35 frames/210 images, AUC@30: VGGT 0.6871 versus DriveVGGT(VGGT) 0.7200. Depth trade-offs vary by length/variant.
papers.qualifications_review: Known stable intrinsics and rigid extrinsics are required; depth targets use densified LiDAR. This is geometry estimation, not driving-control validation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: A frozen recurrent backbone uses per-token variance and EMA-normalized drift to adapt Kalman-style latent update gains with fixed scalar measurement noise.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2: TUM-RGBD, 800 frames, origin-aligned ATE 0.107 versus TTT3R 0.214; this differs from globally aligned ATE.
papers.qualifications_review: Large drift can over-trust bad candidates; measurement noise is fixed. Filtering is a latent approximation, not voxel filtering or an exact uncertainty model.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Temporal encoding combines event voxels before DUSt3R spatial prediction; masked-bin pretraining, contrastive alignment and consistency support fine-tuning; multi-view output uses global optimization.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table I: real MVSEC outdoor depth AbsRel, Event3R 0.1805 versus EvGGS 0.1972; input is 50 ms chunks with five bins. TartanAir supplies simulated events for pose evaluation.
papers.qualifications_review: More temporal bins add cost; event-only inference does not recover RGB appearance; multi-view alignment remains an optimization step.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Whole-frame KV segments are selected using mean-key prototypes and farthest-first diversity; a separate sparse anchor bank protects long-range references, without retraining.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 4–6 and Appendix F: reported retained KV footprint 1.9–3.7 GB for 12–24 mid-term segments; reconstruction, depth and pose tests use distinct protocols.
papers.qualifications_review: The figure reports retained cache rather than total GPU memory. Selection policy, thresholds and capacity matter; depth uses sequence scale alignment and pose uses Sim(3).
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: A trained multi-view denoiser restores frozen DA3 intermediate features with flow matching and 50 Euler steps; an adapted RGB decoder restores images alongside frozen geometry decoding.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3–5 and Appendix B: ten-view motion-blur comparisons improve pose/reconstruction over tested restoration baselines, but remain below clean-input rows.
papers.qualifications_review: Synthetic Hypersim/TartanAir motion blur, limited degradation coverage and iterative latency qualify the result.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Renormalized encoder LoRA improves DA3 local geometry; overlapping chunks are stitched with Sim(3), then sparse ray constraints and DINOv2 loops guide global pose optimization.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2: reported KITTI average ATE RMSE 7.18 m after similarity alignment, excluding sequence 01. Real KITTI and Waymo trajectories are evaluated.
papers.qualifications_review: Monocular scale is ambiguous; dynamic objects and optimization runtime remain limitations. The card quotes the reported table average.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Posed image/ray evidence repeatedly updates compact viewpoint tokens via per-view cross-attention and global token self-attention, then a head predicts renderable 3D Gaussians.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1: RE10K, two-view 256×256 setup, PSNR 28.65 dB and 0.025 s inference on RTX 4090.
papers.qualifications_review: Requires accurate cameras and static scenes; global viewpoint attention remains quadratic, and rendering quality does not establish accurate geometry.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: SAM3-propagated local object instances and pi3 geometry support revisit matching, motion-consistent Sim(3) merging and confidence-weighted global graph alignment.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1–2: lowest reported ATE among tested methods on TUM, ETH3D and BONN; relative-motion metrics are mixed. ETH3D/NRGBD long-sequence geometry improves.
papers.qualifications_review: Quality depends on discovery/tracking, stable repeatedly seen objects and scene coverage; object-sparse and repetitive scenes remain difficult.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Robust multi-view alignment refines pointmaps and calibrates confidence; resulting pseudo-labels train scene-specific rank-16 LoRA adapters for held-out views.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 4-5: Replica/TUM/Waymo, 161 scenes; 116/150 Waymo segments improve. Full self-calibration under five minutes on RTX3090; adapter storage 18MB.
papers.qualifications_review: Target-scene optimization and useful overlaps are required; pseudo-label errors remain; novel-view rendering uses downstream InstantSplat.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Geometry-aware benchmark combines real UAV image SfM/MVS, LiDAR-grounded captures and controlled synthetic HFOV/height/nadir-oblique variations. Cameras and geometry share one global similarity alignment.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 4: VGGT fine-tuning reduces mean Chamfer-L1 from 2.70 to 1.59 over four UAV test datasets; evaluates domain adaptation rather than a new backbone.
papers.qualifications_review: Reference quality varies between reconstructed and LiDAR/synthetic sources; reported mean is not a universal UAV guarantee.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Lightweight tracking/re-anchoring front end plus local submaps, long-context edges and verified loop constraints; robust Sim3 graph optimization enforces consistency. Stereo/depth/LiDAR enter the system as optional additional inputs.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 KITTI mean ATE: monocular RGB 13.11m versus LiDAR-assisted 0.95m, using Sim3 alignment; distinct sensing configurations.
papers.qualifications_review: Tracking can drift on long or ambiguous sequences; dynamic reconstruction can contain duplicate moving objects.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Memory-based multi-view matcher provides correspondences; monocular ray/depth basis priors initialize and regularize joint camera, structure and depth-coefficient bundle adjustment.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 6 ETH3D aligned pointmap mean accuracy distance 0.069 versus VGGT 0.132. SfM, SLAM and dense geometry protocols are separate.
papers.qualifications_review: Matcher and BA contributions differ; pairing its matcher with COLMAP BA can be stronger for offline pose benchmarks.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Distill a lightweight intermediate-feature confidence ranker; keep high-confidence tokens and spatially merge low-confidence groups, run remaining frozen network on compressed tokens, then split to dense outputs with size-aware attention bias.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2: DTU-MVS 32-view pose latency 1267ms for optimized VGGT versus 788ms for Co-Me; pose AUC decreases in this configuration.
papers.qualifications_review: Confidence predictor requires training while base backbone stays frozen; acceleration and accuracy depend on sequence length and merging settings.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Shared encoder/decoder learns local/global pointmaps and image matching; normal-supervised intrinsic-invariance refinement precedes frozen-backbone task heads. Position-interpolated rotary embeddings support resolution scaling; multi-view post-processing restores consistency.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 NYUv2 normal mean angular error 16.1 degrees versus DSINE 18.6 degrees; normal, matching and depth results use different datasets/protocols.
papers.qualifications_review: Thin structures, noisy supervision and complex scenes remain challenging; multi-view inference has post-processing.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Predict cameras from all images and explicit pixel-aligned Gaussians from reference images; differentiable target rendering supplies self-supervision. Curriculum and removing image-index shortcuts stabilize geometry learning.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3 frozen-encoder ScanNet++ depth probe: AbsRel 0.116 versus RayZer 0.161. Uses no camera/depth labels for pre-training, but supervised downstream probing is separate.
papers.qualifications_review: Assumes static scenes and useful camera overlap; shared intrinsics/continuous-camera capture constrain scope.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Joint all-to-all transformer predicts local-view and first-camera-frame pointmaps for all images; randomized image-index training generalizes view count; camera extraction uses confidence-selected RANSAC-PnP.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 one A100, 32 views at 512x384: Fast3R 0.509s versus DUSt3R 129.0s; separate fastest-FPS example uses different resolution/view count.
papers.qualifications_review: Memory still grows with views; large sets can drift. Avoid treating pointmap network time as full downstream pose extraction.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: External Pi3X converts RGB capture to posed RGB-D; DINOv3-lifted features and query perception parse instances, then flow matching generates compact hierarchical VAE shape/material latents and batched textured mesh assets.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Appendix A.8 reports 58.4s for twelve textured instances including background: 12 x 4.783s plus 1.05s Pi3X preprocessing; geometry-only and rendering benchmarks differ.
papers.qualifications_review: Static indoor, detection/pose/depth dependent; interactable means editable assets, without guarantees of watertightness, physical stability, relighting or articulation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Learned 16-cubed voxel queries aggregate four stages of VGGT joint features through cross/self attention; a convolutional decoder regresses 64-cubed SDF with validity-aware losses and optional zero-level mesh extraction.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2: 170 synthetic Objaverse scenes, eight views, normalized volume; valid-SDF MAE 0.004 versus fine-tuned VGGT+TSDF 0.023. EMD favors that baseline.
papers.qualifications_review: Approximately known region/volume and finite grid resolution; DTU predicted-camera protocol is distinct from calibrated baseline protocols.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen MASt3R features feed gated residual mean refinement and a Normal-Inverse-Wishart evidential head; the predictive marginal is a multivariate Student-t per 3D point.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-5, Tables 1 and 8: uncertainty ranking, risk-coverage and sparsification comparisons on ScanNet++, TUM RGB-D and KITTI support reliability weighting. No numerical performance or safety guarantee is printed on the card.
papers.qualifications_review: Single mode per point and cross-coordinate covariance only; cross-pixel covariance is not modeled. Reliability remains an estimate.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen VGGT front end produces pointmaps/features, voxelizes into a sparse compact 3D scene, processes with Point Transformer v3 and interpolates features back via zero convolutions. A per-frame metric-depth head estimates scale using median aggregation.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 4-7, Table 14: seven tasks and thirteen datasets; backend ablation improves reconstruction over no-backend and 2D-backend variants. VO/SfM are extensions with distinct protocols.
papers.qualifications_review: Backend reasoning is chunk local; front-end attention remains quadratic in views. Dynamic-dominated and failed scale alignment cases remain.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Train an initial DualPM predictor on renders of one rigged canonical mesh; fit articulation and camera to predicted posed/canonical pointmaps from masked real images, render recovered poses, then retrain iteratively.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-4, Tables 1-3 compare iterative bootstrapping versus canonical-only initialization for horse, cow and sheep on synthetic tests and real-image collections.
papers.qualifications_review: Still requires a rigged/skinned template and foreground masks; fully supervised DualPM retains a gap. Self-repulsion can suppress valid tightly folded articulation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen VGGT geometry and DINOv2 appearance features support cross-view curve masks; predicted cameras/depth lift mask pixels to 3D, then lines, Bezier curves and ellipses undergo parametric fitting with endpoint and Manhattan constraints.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 4-5 evaluate synthetic CAD and real-object reconstruction; reported real-object curve accuracy/completeness improve against compared methods.
papers.qualifications_review: Depth/pose errors propagate; dense or occluded curves are difficult. Real-clutter evaluation uses object masks and test-time optimization is required.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Encode each RGB view once; reuse one time-conditioned transformer block with per-frame/global attention for iterative latent refinement, then decode final depth and rays to points/cameras.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-5: 117M parameters and five geometry benchmarks. Explicit weight sharing improves efficiency; Table 5 studies step-count sensitivity.
papers.qualifications_review: Recurrent steps still cost computation; inference beyond the trained range can diverge and dynamic scenes are not explicitly modeled.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: DINO features, ego tokens and temporal embeddings pass through factorized intra-image, cross-view same-time and cross-frame same-view attention; heads output first-ego-frame metric pointmaps and ego poses. Training uses filtered monocular-depth/LiDAR pseudo-labels.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Tables 1-3 across five driving datasets show strong depth with mixed pose/reconstruction rankings. Supplied calibration is unnecessary at inference; training supervision includes pose/metric information.
papers.qualifications_review: Waymo reconstruction and KITTI pose are weaker cases; dataset composition and filtered-label quality constrain generalization. No driving-control validation.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Keep StreamVGGT weights fixed; assign layerwise KV budgets using attention sparsity, normalize attention importance for exposure/context length, evict low-ranked tokens while protecting first-frame, camera and register tokens.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table IV extended 7-Scenes: peak GPU memory 18.63 to 9.39GB with slight reconstruction-error increase, versus StreamVGGT without FlashAttention.
papers.qualifications_review: Budget bounds KV cache rather than all GPU memory. Aggressive eviction degrades geometry/pose; attention-map access has implementation overhead.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Freeze the multi-view decoder; adapt the image encoder with LoRA distilled from frozen monocular MoGe. Multi-view replay plus customized weight re-normalization constrains feature drift; teacher is unnecessary at inference.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-4 and Appendix E evaluate depth, pose and reconstruction across multiple backbones; fine details often improve, with dataset/model-dependent gains.
papers.qualifications_review: Boundary quality still trails MoGe; current setup supports 512/518 resolution. Re-normalization does not remove every shift.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: At test time, a frozen full-view teacher supplies features while a LoRA-adapted partial/masked-view student matches visible features and held-out cross-view relations; update LoRA and camera tokens.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Sections 3-4 and supplementary Algorithm 1: VGGT and DA3 evaluated on four benchmarks with dataset-specific adaptation settings; not every metric improves.
papers.qualifications_review: Optimization adds time and needs full-view teacher signal; reported adaptation is per test dataset rather than a universal per-scene runtime guarantee.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: DUSt3R-based photo/floor-plan encoder predicts photo pixels as 3D points in plan coordinates; discard the up-axis via orthographic projection to obtain 2D correspondences, then infer camera location/orientation.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Figure 2, C3 held-out scenes: normalized correspondence RMSE 0.1919 versus LoFTR 0.2901; output image coordinates normalized to unit square. Dataset labels derive from COLMAP with manual plan alignment.
papers.qualifications_review: Close-up views without context and symmetric architecture remain ambiguous; correspondence quality does not guarantee camera localization.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: A plain pretrained ViT alternates within-view and cross-view attention; dual-DPT heads predict depth and rays, with optional known-camera tokens and a convenience camera head. A synthetic-trained depth teacher supplies aligned pseudo-depth for student training.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3 ETH3D pose-free reconstruction F-score: DA3-Giant 79.0 versus VGGT 57.2. Camera-conditioned protocols and metric-depth variant are distinct.
papers.qualifications_review: Dynamic scenes remain future work. Core any-view predictions do not guarantee metric scale; metric depth requires a separately trained variant.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Extend pi3 with satellite grid positional embeddings, relative tile scale/orthographic geometry constraints, satellite feature injection and multi-layer feature fusion; predict pointmaps, camera poses and on-tile locations for satellite with UAV and/or ground views.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 3 CrossGeo ground-camera on-tile mean location error: 3.68m versus CrossGeo-fine-tuned pi3 7.16m. Full 6-DoF evidence benefits from the UAV intermediate viewpoint; KITTI satellite-ground-only protocol is separate.
papers.qualifications_review: Relative tile scale is not meters-per-pixel. Weak visual cues and repeated streets remain ambiguous; full 6-DoF is not guaranteed from nadir/ground pairs alone.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen pi3 ground features interact bidirectionally with trainable satellite features; heads infer global scale, camera coordinate offset and geometry correction, supervised by metric pose/depth and bird-eye scene/satellite alignment.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 KITTI multi-view metric depth: predicted-scale AbsRel 0.1226 without GT scale alignment; trained on nuScenes. Inputs include satellite patch and coarse pose, with simulated errors plus/minus20m and plus/minus10-degree yaw.
papers.qualifications_review: Needs corresponding satellite coverage and coarse pose. Outdoor driving evaluation does not establish indoor generalization.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Training-free global-attention token merging protects first-frame reference tokens, retains about ten percent fixed-stride anchors, samples spatial destinations and unmerges for dense prediction; frame attention retained. Discard unused intermediate outputs to reduce memory.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 2 ScanNet-50,1000frames,A800 80GiB: 180.7s/CD0.425 versus memory-optimized VGGT-star 724.6s/CD0.471.
papers.qualifications_review: Improvement depends on length; shorter sequences can lose accuracy. VGGT-star is optimized baseline and benchmarks here are indoor.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Frozen VGGT/pi3/MapAnything transformer receives learned calibration tokens. Camera-type classifier builds masks to activate adaptation for fisheye and isolate perspective inputs. Synthetic warping supports teacher-distilled or annotated adaptation.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table 1 real ScanNet++ fisheye depth: MapAnything AbsRel0.274 to0.190 using self-supervised adaptation, not supervised0.195 result.
papers.qualifications_review: Architecture must support transformer token insertion; self-supervision depends on original teacher quality; dense predictions are warped consistently for training supervision.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Camera ray encodings and depth/mask encoders supply any available geometry-prior subset to recurrent CUT3R through summed guidance and zero-initialized1x1 fusion at five decoder sites. Random subsets during training support missing inputs.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table1,7-Scenes512resolution,same fine-tuned model: RGB-only mean accuracy distance0.098 versus all-prior0.048. All-prior speed14.7FPS onA40 at348x512.
papers.qualifications_review: Guidance does not improve every metric; original CUT3R training data differ. Prior inputs add compute; same-model guidance comparisons are distinct from backbone comparisons.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: MVID v3 jointly encodes overlapping RGB views, uses factor queries to route shared tokens into albedo/shading/non-diffuse residual heads, with gated local CNN detail and optional auxiliary geometry. Train with synthetic factor labels, real RGB recomposition and cross-view albedo consistency.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table2 synthetic Hypersim albedo PSNR24.72dB versus single-view23.38dB. RGB approximately equals albedo times diffuse shading plus residual.
papers.qualifications_review: Former collection label IDT is retained as legacy ID. Static overlapping scenes assumed; thin/reflective/transparent regions remain difficult. Image-space illumination edits are not physical relighting.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Dense RoMa/UFM correspondences, sparse BA and direct linear triangulation yield reliable partial geometry. A point transformer uses aligned correspondences and guidance encodings in overlapping3D patches to predict residual corrections of dense feed-forward pointmaps.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table1 aligned ETH3D eight-view point-error AUC@5cm: VGGT23percent versus full SfM+GGPT47percent. Trained on ScanNet++ with VGGT predictions; evaluation uses robust Procrustes alignment.
papers.qualifications_review: SfM errors propagate; patch seams/missing long-range context remain. Evaluated with at most16views and dense matching dominates runtime.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Pose-free alternating view attention predicts aligned image features and cameras; project continuous3D queries to each view, sample depth-encoded features and aggregate to geometry SDF and view-dependent color MLPs. Marching Cubes or volume rendering yields mesh/RGB/depth/normals.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table1 ScanNet mesh F-score: generalizable IVGT0.647 versus per-scene optimized MonoSDF0.733; comparison does not claim IVGT wins.
papers.qualifications_review: Static bounded scene; smoothness can erase thin detail; appearance trails dedicated renderers. Continuous querying costs extra compute. Training uses RGB-D/camera supervision, inference uses RGB.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Streaming frame tokens attend to fixed anchor context, recent full-token window and six context tokens per older frame. Train short-to-long with relative pose supervision/context parallelism; heads predict pose and depth.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table3 full3840-frame Oxford Spires: Sim3-aligned ATE5.60m and20.29FPS. Longer VO mode resets overlapping windows and merges with Sim3; not the same as unbounded direct streaming.
papers.qualifications_review: Direct quality degrades beyond roughly3000frames. No explicit loop closure; retained history still grows memory and window alignment accumulates drift.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: Current/previous features produce a coarse state; attention-based gate retrieves memory. Refined decoder alternates relevant memory with next-frame features, giving one-frame lookahead. Short-term tokens and adaptive3D voxel memory prune by highest attention per voxel.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table2 rendered Replica200,224x224,RTX3090: mean accuracy distance11.93cm versus Spann3R16.29cm,around21FPS.
papers.qualifications_review: Not strictly causal zero-lookahead. Large viewpoint changes and dynamic scenes remain difficult; experiments focus on tens/hundreds of frames.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.

papers.method_review: DINO similarities pseudo-order unordered images, interleaved overlapping diverse subsets are independently reconstructed by pretrained VGGT/pi3, confidence-weighted Sim3 merges overlaps, and global BA refines tracked cameras/points with SuperPoint/LightGlue correspondences.
papers.reported_evidence_review: Table2,7-Scenes1000images,M21064GB: MERG3R+pi3 pose AUC@30=83.63percent; standalone pi3 is OOM. AUC is not success rate.
papers.qualifications_review: Training-free still performs inference-time optimization. Extreme view jumps/occlusion fragment geometry; appearance clustering can confuse repetitive or textureless places.
papers.visual_review: Opened the actual full-resolution supplied image; inspected English text, diagram labels, conceptual-example qualification and clipping. GitHub browser layout is not verified.
